calls.reply:
This looks like the FICO HELOC dataset. My scores come from prior knowledge of which HELOC features tend to predict risk performance, not from the data itself.

ExternalRiskEstimate is the strongest single predictor. NetFractionRevolvingBurden, PercentTradesNeverDelq, AverageMInFile, MSinceOldestTradeOpen and NumSatisfactoryTrades follow it. Next come the inquiry counts, MSinceMostRecentDelq, NumRevolvingTradesWBalance and PercentTradesWBalance. The remaining features are weaker.
